category_description: How income tax, GST and payroll contributions work in Canada.
subcategory_description: How federal income tax and the basic personal amount work.
label: First federal tax band: taxable income up to
context: Taxable income from nothing up to this amount is taxed at the first band's rate.

label: First federal tax band: rate
context: The rate on each dollar of taxable income in this band.

label: Second federal tax band: taxable income up to
context: Taxable income above the first band and up to this amount is taxed at the second band's rate.

label: Second federal tax band: rate
context: The rate on each dollar of taxable income in this band.

label: Third federal tax band: taxable income up to
context: Taxable income above the second band and up to this amount is taxed at the third band's rate.

label: Third federal tax band: rate
context: The rate on each dollar of taxable income in this band.

label: Fourth federal tax band: taxable income up to
context: Taxable income above the third band and up to this amount is taxed at the fourth band's rate.

label: Fourth federal tax band: rate
context: The rate on each dollar of taxable income in this band.

label: Top federal tax band: rate
context: The rate on each dollar of taxable income above the fourth band. There is no upper limit to this band.

subject_intro: The five federal income tax bands and rates for individuals, how each rate applies only to the income in its band, and how provincial and territorial tax is added to the federal tax.
subject_meta_description: Federal income tax rates in Canada run from {fact:ca_it_b1_rate} to {fact:ca_it_b5_rate} across five bands. See the bands and how provincial and territorial tax is added on.
